assets.brief: Wide painted anime/gouache Bangalore street at blue hour, left dark teal rain-tree space for title, right mint and terracotta shops, pink bougainvillea, warm windows and fairy lights, empty foreground paving; no characters, text or UI.
Transparent painted game collectible 2x2 atlas: yellow scooty and green helmet; green coconut with straw; momos and red chutney; ruby heart with two ivory horns. Ink edges, gold teal accents.
